content: LAMA covers different sources: The Google-RE set covers the three relations “place of birth”, “date of birth” and “place of death”. T-REx BIBREF4 consists of a subset of Wikidata triples covering 41 relations. ConceptNet BIBREF5 combines 16 commonsense relationships between words and/or phrases. The underlying Open Mind Common Sense corpus provides matching statements to query the language model. SQuAD BIBREF6 is a standard question answering dataset. LAMA contains a subset of 305 context-insensitive questions and provides manually reformulated cloze-style statements to query the model.
